Vamos juntos?   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Realizar atendimento presencial aos usuários a partir das solicitações recebidas pelo Service Desk ou diretamente pelo responsável do serviço, via sistemas, respeitando os níveis mínimos de serviço.  Realizar deslocamento quando necessário para atendimento e suporte a partir das solicitações recebidas pelo Service Desk ou direcionadas pela Supervisão da equipe. Minimizar o impacto dos incidentes de hardware ou sistema operacional que não podem ser prevenidos.  Elaborar relatórios e pareceres técnicos sobre as questões pertinentes ao serviço.  Efetuar análise dos requisitos de hardware para instalação de softwares.  Testar funcionalidades de novos equipamentos, componentes ou periféricos, e elaborar guias ou manuais para os usuários.  Montar, desmontar, instalar, desinstalar e configurar equipamentos de TIC, seus componentes e periféricos, tais como microcomputadores, notebooks, impressoras, scanners, fax, monitores, teclado, mouse, telefones celulares, modems, etc.  Configurar agentes de monitoração em máquinas. REQUER CERTIFICAÇÃO:   Certificação ITIL Foundation V3 ou superior, ou Certificação HDI;  Certificação profissional para suporte a sistemas Windows 10 ou superior.    Experiência desejável: 02 anos em atividades relacionadas, 01 ano com no mínimo 04 (quatro) disciplinas ITIL, sistemas Android.  Conhecimento em Windows, sistemas Android.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Se você domina plataformas como AWS, Azure ou GCP e possui inglês avançado/fluente para interação com times globais, queremos conhecer você.  Responsabilidades e atribuições   Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de soluções em nuvem, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, performance e resiliência.  Estabelecer padrões arquiteturais, frameworks de governança e boas práticas para o uso de cloud dentro da organização.  Atuar no desenho de ambientes cloud-native, considerando alta disponibilidade, automação e observabilidade.  Apoiar decisões estratégicas relacionadas à modernização de aplicações, migração para cloud e evolução tecnológica.  Atuar em parceria com times de engenharia, dados, segurança e produto, garantindo alinhamento entre arquitetura e necessidades de negócio.  Definir roadmaps de evolução arquitetural, identificando oportunidades de melhoria de performance, custo e escalabilidade.  Garantir adoção de boas práticas de segurança, identidade e governança em cloud.  Apoiar iniciativas de containerização, orquestração e automação de infraestrutura.  Atuar na definição de arquiteturas baseadas em microsserviços, APIs e sistemas distribuídos.  Contribuir para decisões relacionadas a observabilidade, monitoramento, logging e gestão de custos em cloud (FinOps).  Apoiar processos de arquitetura de referência, revisões técnicas e direcionamento das squads de engenharia.    Habilidades e Requisitos   Experiência sólida como Arquiteto(a) de Cloud ou Arquiteto(a) de Soluções.  Forte experiência com plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud Platform).  Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e aplicações cloud-native.  Experiência com infraestrutura como código (IaC) e automação de ambientes.  Vivência com containers e orquestração (Docker / Kubernetes).  Conhecimento em arquitetura de APIs, integração de sistemas e microsserviços.  Experiência com segurança em cloud, identidade e controle de acesso.  Conhecimento em observabilidade, monitoramento e gestão de logs.  Vivência em ambientes corporativos complexos e de missão crítica.  Capacidade de liderança técnica e influência em decisões arquiteturais.  Inglês avançado ou fluente (obrigatório) para interação com times e stakeholders internacionais.  Certificações em cloud como: AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect.  Experiência com estratégias de modernização e migração para cloud.  Vivência com FinOps e otimização de custos em ambientes cloud.  Experiência com plataformas de dados em cloud (Data Lake, Big Data, Analytics).  Atuação em arquiteturas multi-cloud ou híbridas. Venha fazer parte dessa jornada e trilhar um caminho que transforma carreiras e futuros.  Responsabilidades e atribuições   Acompanhar as atividades de manutenção corretiva e preventiva de instalações, equipamentos e máquinas.  Elaborar procedimentos de trabalho e plano de manutenção para identificar as deficiências operacionais e funcionais e atende as necessidades de infraestrutura.  Supervisionar as equipes de manutenção e suporte técnico.  Contratar e supervisionar profissionais especializados.  Recrutar, supervisionar e treinar os eletricistas e assistentes de manutenção.  Fechamento do ponto das equipes de manutenção.  Acompanhar as manutenções através do sistema (software) de Manutenção.  Realizar feedbacks nas equipes de manutenção.  Garantir o cumprimento das normas de qualidade e dos regulamentos de saúde e segurança.  Gestão do estoque de peças sobressalentes e estoque de manutenção.  Controle das despesas e orçamentos das contas de manutenção.  Gestão dos indicadores de manutenção.  Controle da disponibilidade de equipamentos.    Ter senso de 5S, Certificações, Segurança do Trabalho e Meio Ambiente.  Requisitos e qualificações   Noções básicas de logística  Curso de NR10 e NR35  Pós graduação ( desejável)  Conhecimento em Elétrica e mecânica  Conhecimento em automação industrial  Conhecimento em POWER BI  Programa de Participação nos Resultados  Convênio com empresas parceiras  Vale refeição e/ou alimentação  Benefício farmácia e vacinação  Assistência odontológica  Assistência médica e telemedicina  Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida  Universidade com cursos pra você e família  Fundo de emergência (apoio financeiro em momentos de crise)  Consultoria de planejamento e organização financeira  Auxílio creche e kit bebê para mamães na RD Saúde  Auxílio funeral    Juntos por uma sociedade mais saudável  Somos RD Saúde, um ecossistema de saúde integral, com mais de 3 mil unidades em todo o Brasil e negócios em saúde que dividem o mesmo propósito: contribuir para uma sociedade mais saudável. Nossa jornada começou em novembro de 2011, fruto da união entre Raia e Drogasil, crescendo até se tornar a maior rede de farmácias do Brasil e expandindo para além do varejo farmacêutico, integrando soluções B2B e plataformas digitais.  Com mais de um milhão de vidas atendidas diariamente em todo o país, cuidar de perto dos(as) nossos(as) clientes e das nossas pessoas está em nosso DNA. Somos mais de 57 mil profissionais comprometidos em construir o futuro da saúde com calor humano e tecnologia. Temos a sustentabilidade no centro da nossa estratégia, dividindo nossa ambição em três pilares: pessoas, negócio e planeta mais saudáveis.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

At Gratia, we believe potential is globally distributed, but opportunity is not. Our mission is to turn great talent's potential into fulfilling global careers through professional development and tech-enabled platforms. We bridge the gap between ambitious companies and hands‑on experts who deliver real results instead of just theoretical plans.  Gratia is a remote-first, apprenticeship-based platform where opportunity is defined by what you can do and deliver. Our clients include global names like USA Today Co., Endeavor, and New York Life. We maintain an 88.2 Net Promoter Score because we focus on rigorous execution, not just high-level advice.  Why join the Gratia community?    Flexibility and Autonomy: Work with top‑tier clients globally while designing a professional rhythm that suits your life. Fair global compensation meets real flexibility.  Apprenticeship and Growth: A curated pathway combining high‑value projects with mentorship. Move from Associate Business Analyst to Engagement Lead through real work, not just theory.  Community and Specialization: Join a supportive ecosystem where you can share knowledge, access opportunities, and develop deep expertise to earn Specialist designations in high‑demand domains.    We are looking for Financial Modelling Specialists across various experience levels to join our delivery team. In this role, you are responsible for building the technical tools that help founders and executives make critical business decisions.  Whether you are mid‑level or highly senior, you will focus on the hands‑on build of integrated models, valuations, and forecasting dashboards. You will work alongside our project leads to turn business goals into reliable, bulletproof financial products.  This is a tiered role; your specific level will be determined during our conversations based on your technical skills, professional journey, and your readiness to manage client relationships.  What You’ll Be Doing    Model Building: Build and scale driver‑based 3‑statement models (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and multi‑year projections.  Valuation Analysis: Perform company and asset valuations using DCF frameworks, comparable company analysis, and precedent transactions.  Scenario Testing: Design "what‑if" frameworks and sensitivity analysis to quantify risk and upside for stakeholders.  Data‑Driven Analysis: Use financial math and modelling techniques to provide technical clarity for market entry, operations, or fundraising.  Deliverable Ownership: Ensure every cell is accurate, logic is transparent, and every visual output is clear for the end‑user.    What We’re Looking For    Professional experience in financial modelling, typically gained within investment banking, private equity, or corporate finance environments.  Comfort with 3‑statement integration, DCF valuations, and data tables. Senior‑level candidates should demonstrate mastery of complex risk‑quantification and advanced simulations.  The ability to transform messy, raw data into structured and logical business solutions.  You thrive when given a spec and expected to deliver a production‑ready model with minimal oversight.  Exceptional communication skills; you must be able to document your assumptions and explain your model logic clearly.    Range of Deliverables   We match projects to your experience level. Deliverables range from:   Junior: Budget templates, revenue/cost projections, and variance analysis.  Intermediate: Fully integrated 3‑statement models and scenario dashboards.  Advanced: Complex LBO/M&A models and risk‑quantification simulations.    Why Gratia is Your Next Step    This is a long‑term contract/freelance role designed for independent professionals who want the freedom of private practice without the isolation of working alone. We offer both part‑time and full‑time engagement options.  Compensation is tailored to your expertise.  Elevate your profile by working directly with leaders at innovative global organizations like Gannett and Portrait Analytics.  We believe in moving from "doing" to "leading". You’ll have a defined trajectory to gain specialized expertise and leadership skills.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Data Analyst II
description:

Why Join Us  Brex is the AI‑powered spend platform. We help companies spend with confidence with integrated corporate cards, banking, and global payments, plus intuitive software for travel and expenses. Data at Brex  The Data organization develops insights, models, and data infrastructure for teams across Brex, including Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Operations. Our Data Scientists, Analysts, and Engineers work together to make data—and insights derived from data—a core asset across the company.  What You’ll Do  As a Data Analyst II (DA), you will play a central role in enhancing the operational tracking and reporting capabilities of different business teams across Brex. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and partner teams to drive meaningful insights for the business through visualizations, self‑service tools, and ad‑hoc analyses. This is a high‑impact role in a fast‑paced fintech environment where your work will directly influence strategic decisions.  Where you’ll work  This role will be based in our São Paulo office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.  Responsibilities   Apply data visualization and storytelling skills in creating business intelligence solutions (such as Looker and/or Hex dashboards) that enable actionable insights.  Perform ad‑hoc analyses and deep dives to investigate business questions, surface trends, and provide data‑driven recommendations.  Develop self‑service data tools and processes that empower business stakeholders to independently monitor the performance and health of their respective areas.  Collaborate closely with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to identify data sources, enable data pipelines, and support the development of analytical data models that operationalize reports and dashboards.  Implement and maintain rigorous data quality checks to ensure the integrity and robustness of datasets used across dashboards, reports, and analyses.  Partner with various departments—including Sales, Operations, Product, and Finance—to understand their data needs and deliver tailored analyses and reporting that support strategic planning.  Contribute to the automation of recurring analyses and reporting workflows using Python.    Requirements   4+ years of experience in data analytics or a related role in a professional setting.  3+ years of experience working directly with Sales, Operations, Product, or equivalent business teams.  Fluency in SQL to manipulate data and perform complex analyses (CTEs, window functions, joins across large datasets).  Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation, and scripting (Pandas, NumPy, and similar libraries).  Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools (Looker, Hex, Tableau, or similar).  Strong quantitative and analytical skills with a demonstrated ability to translate data into business insights.  Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across different functions and levels of technical fluency.  Experience with generative AI and LLM‑based tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to perform and accelerate analyses, automated reporting, and build self‑service data tools.    Bonus points   Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks).  Familiarity with dbt for data modeling and transformation.  Exposure to data pipeline orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow).  Experience in fintech, financial services, or payments.  Comfort operating in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment with evolving priorities.    Please be aware, job‑seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Na Mindsight, desenvolvemos softwares inteligentes para a gestão de pessoas. Nossa missão é levar escalabilidade e embasamento às decisões sobre candidatos e colaboradores, unindo tecnologia e metodologia. Buscamos pessoas que queiram impactar e evoluir o mercado, encarando com energia os desafios do nosso ambiente. Nosso propósito é tornar as decisões sobre gente mais justas, impulsionando resultados reais para o RH.  O QUE VALORIZAMOS NO NOSSO TIME   Profundidade  Generalismo  Franqueza  Talentos são o nosso core  Evolução constante    Resolvemos problemas da melhor maneira possível, aplicando conhecimento na prática e transformando teoria em valor. Valorizamos pessoas que conhecem um pouco de tudo e não têm medo de contribuir com opiniões para resolver desafios. Somos diretos. Não incentivamos politicagem nem esforços para “aparecer”. Nosso foco é evoluir o produto e inovar. Somos uma empresa orientada a pessoas, não à burocracia. A autonomia vem com responsabilidade, confiança e qualidade nas entregas — microgestão não faz parte do nosso dia a dia. Estamos sempre avaliando, ajustando e buscando melhorar. Quando necessário, mudamos rápido para chegar ao melhor resultado possível.  O QUE ESPERAR DA MINDSIGHT   Impulsionamos seu desenvolvimento  Autonomia real  Flexibilidade de verdade  Seja você mesmo  Transparência sempre    Somos um ambiente de desafios, onde aprendizado vira prática. Oferecemos auxílio educação para apoiar seu crescimento com livros, cursos e eventos. Nossa estrutura é horizontal. Você é dono das suas entregas — com independência, iniciativa e responsabilidade. Pouca burocracia e muita flexibilidade. Você organiza seus próprios horários, seja no modelo remoto ou híbrido. Temos escritório de apoio em São Paulo. Não julgamos aparência, roupas, cargos ou status. Valorizamos autenticidade e impacto. Feedback é parte da nossa cultura. E quando o assunto é sensível, você conta com o apoio da nossa Ouvidoria.  COMO É FAZER PARTE DO NOSSO TIME COMERCIAL?  Fazer parte do time comercial da Mindsight é ser responsável por mover o crescimento da empresa. Nossa missão é clara: garantir um crescimento sustentável e previsível, trazendo novos clientes, expandindo nossa base ativa e fortalecendo a Mindsight como referência no mercado de RH. Cada pessoa da área comercial contribui diretamente para esse propósito. Aqui, o trabalho não é apenas vender — é entender profundamente o cliente, diagnosticar suas dores e conectar nossa solução ao impacto real que ela gera na operação dele. É aprendizado constante, evolução rápida e responsabilidade desde o primeiro dia. É uma trilha para quem gosta de desafios, de pensar com visão de dono e de fazer parte de um time que trabalha com propósito: entregar impacto real para nossos clientes e para o mercado de RH.  POSSIBILIDADES DE ATUAÇÃO  Dentro da Trilha Comercial, você pode se desenvolver em diferentes frentes, cada uma contribuindo para o mesmo objetivo: crescimento sustentável, geração de valor e impacto no cliente.  ➡️ Pré-Vendas  O início da jornada para quem quer aprender a analisar contextos, qualificar leads e gerar oportunidades reais. Excelente porta de entrada para desenvolvimento comercial.  ➡️ Vendas  Atuação direta com diagnóstico, demonstração e fechamento. Aqui você se aprofunda na nossa tese de valor e na capacidade de transformar o negócio dos clientes.  ➡️ Parcerias (Sales Partnerships)  Atuação com parceiros estratégicos, construindo iniciativas que expandem nossa presença e fortalecem nossa base de clientes.  Impacto Esperado    1. Aprender a gerar valor antes de gerar venda: a trilha começa desenvolvendo uma visão consultiva: analisar o cliente, entender o contexto, identificar oportunidades e conectar necessidades ao potencial dos nossos produtos. O foco é sempre impacto, nunca transação.    2. Construir oportunidades — não esperar por elas: a área comercial funciona como um motor estratégico da empresa.  Na Trilha, Você Aprende a   criar demanda,  qualificar conversas,  transformar dores em propostas de valor,  e acompanhar oportunidades do início ao fim.    Independente da frente de atuação você participa da construção ativa do crescimento da Mindsight.    3. Desenvolver visão de negócio e escuta estratégica: aqui você aprende a conversar com empresas de diferentes portes e maturidades, traduzir desafios em soluções e apresentar valor de forma clara.    4. Crescer com base em impacto e entrega real: a trilha comercial tem espaço para quem aprende rápido, gosta de desafios e quer crescer. Aqui, desenvolvimento não é promessa: é rotina. Com feedbacks, rituais, acompanhamento e projetos reais, você evolui enquanto ajuda a escalar a empresa.  Skills Relevantes   Comunicação consultiva  Análise de contexto e diagnóstico  Visão estratégica de funil e jornada  Entendimento profundo do produto e do impacto gerado  Negociação e storytelling de valor  Trabalho em equipe e colaboração entre áreas  Capacidade de gerar crescimento real e mensurável      Curtiu até aqui?Se você se enxergou nessas possibilidades e quer crescer em um time guiado por impacto, desempenho e aprendizado contínuo,➡️ Se inscreva no nosso Banco de Talentos. Quem sabe seu próximo passo não é aqui com a gente?   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Apply if you are an exceptional Go, Rust or C/C++ engineer and want to work on next‑generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage. Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure are essential for modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro‑service architecture, or cloud infrastructure.  Here are some examples of projects underway at Canonical:   RustVMM  – a new hypervisor for Linux focused on performance, security and operability.  Rockcraft  – an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.  LXD  – a modern system container and virtual machine manager used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms, covering low‑level kernel work, filesystems, VMMs, networking, and higher‑level REST API and CLI. OpenStack (Charmed OpenStack, OVN/OVS, Ceph)  – delivering cloud platform technologies to large‑scale computing environments. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions.    What We Are Looking For in You   An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.  Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about an alternative path.  Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations.  Experience working on open‑source virtualisation or container technology.  Experience working in the kernel or very low‑level system.  Professional written and spoken English.  Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred).  Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.  Passion, thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation.  Excellent communication and presentation skills.  Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments.  Ability to travel twice a year for company events up to two weeks each.    Additional Skills We Value   Performance engineering and security experience.    What We Offer You   Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.  Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.  Annual compensation review.  Recognition rewards.  Annual holiday leave.  Maternity and paternity leave.  Employee Assistance Programme.  Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.  Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events. Diversity of experience, perspectives and background creates a better work environment and better products. The result: prioritize the customer interactions that matter most. NPS Prism customers use our customer experience benchmarks and insights to propel their growth and outpace the competition. Launched in 2019, NPS Prism has rapidly grown to a team of over 200, serving dozens of clients around the world. NPS Prism is 100% owned by Bain & Company, one of the top management consulting firms in the world and a companyconsistently recognizedas one of the world’s best places to work. We believe that diversity,inclusion,and collaborationarekey to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents,abilities,and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive professionally and personally. WHAT YOU'LL DO  NPS Prism is seeking a Product Manager who will own the definition and delivery of analytics- and primary-research–based products, including AI-enabled capabilities, that directly drive NPS Prism’s growth over the next fiveyears..This role is ideal for a hands-on product leader who thrives as an individual contributor, brings a strong customer-first mindset, and can work effectively across cross-functional teams across geographies to take products from idea to launch. Key Responsibilities  Own end-to-end product development across the full lifecycle: ideation, discovery, scoping, prioritization, build, launch, and post-launch iteration   Lead new product development efforts to create new analytics and primary research products, including AI-enabled capabilities, aligned to long-term NPS Prism growth   Own product strategy and roadmap decisions for your product area, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and business impact. Stay current on trends in analytics, AI, research methodologies, and market needs to inform product strategy   This role is designed for a Product Manager who wants meaningful ownership, exposure to complex customer problems, and the opportunity to grow into a senior product leader over time. ABOUT YOU  Required  5+ years of experience in product management, product development, or a closely related role  Professional-level proficiency in written and spoken English is required for this role  Demonstrated experience delivering products across the full development spectrum, from concept to launch  Strong customer-centric mindset with experience working backwards from user needs   Experience building or managing analytics-driven, research-based, and/or AI-enabled data products, including working with engineering, data science, commercial and/or operations team members   Proven ability tooperateas a hands-on individual contributor with ownership mindset, influencing cross-functional teams without formal authority   Strong data analysis skills (e.g.SQL, Alteryx, Excel, etc.)   Strong problem-solving skills and comfortoperatingin ambiguous environments   Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to work across geographies and cultures and communicate technical topics to non-technical audiences   Preferred  Experience with B2B SaaS, data platforms, analytics products, or research-based offerings   Experience with primary research and/or surveymethodology   Familiarity with AI/ML concepts (LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG applications, etc.) and their application in customer insights or analytics products   Experience in top tier strategyconsulting   Experience managing junior team members     #J-18808-Ljbffr

About us  Cyncly is a leading global provider of specialized visualization, sales, manufacturing and content software and solutions for the retail, design and manufacturing industries.  Cyncly was created to unite Compusoft, 2020 Technologies and their affiliate companies after their merger in 2021. The Company brings together more than 35 years of industry experience to provide a connected platform of configure, price, quote (CPQ) software, online space planning, computer-aided design (CAD) applications, business process management, manufacturing execution systems and enterprise resource planning (ERP). Cyncly serves more than 70,000 customers across 100 countries, with operations in North America, Europe, South America, Asia Pacific, and Africa.  At Cyncly, we are committed to fostering an increasingly diverse and inclusive environment where all voices are valued and celebrated. We prioritize representation from minority groups. We recognize that our unique approach and success stem from the wealth of perspectives brought by our diverse teams.  About the role  As a Contract Lifecycle Analyst, you will manage the full post-sale contract lifecycle (amendments, renewals, changes, and churn events), to ensure accuracy, compliance, and a seamless customer experience. Acting as the operational owner of all contract updates, this role collaborates closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to keep contracts aligned with commercial intent. Strong Salesforce experience, exceptional attention to detail, and a solid understanding of SaaS subscription contracts and commercial operations are essential.  Main responsibilities   Own and manage all contract activity after initial deal close, including:  Upsells, downsells, partial churn, and full churn events  Renewal preparation, execution, and contract continuation  Ensure all changes are accurately reflected in Salesforce and downstream systems.    Amendment & Change Management   Review, validate, and process contract amendments in line with company policies and commercial approvals.  Act as the operational bridge between Sales/CS and Legal for non-standard terms or escalations.  Ensure amendments are correctly documented, versioned, and auditable.    Renewal Operations   Manage the operational execution of renewals, ensuring:  Correct pricing, products, and contract terms  Alignment with previous amendments and customer entitlements  Support Account Managers and Customer Success with renewal readiness and accuracy.    Salesforce & Systems Excellence   Maintain high data integrity across Salesforce, including:  Contract records, renewal dates, terms, and product configurations  Leverage Salesforce reporting and dashboards to track lifecycle activity, churn, and renewals.  Identify opportunities for automation and process optimization within Salesforce and related tools.    Order & Commercial Review   Review incoming orders, amendments, and renewal documentation for:  Pricing accuracy  Policy compliance  Contractual consistency  Flag discrepancies and drive resolution before execution.    Cross-Functional Collaboration   Partner closely with:  Sales & Customer Success on contract changes and renewals  Finance on billing alignment and revenue accuracy  Legal on non-standard terms and contractual exceptions  Act as the primary operational point of contact for post-sale contract questions.    Process Improvement & Governance   Continuously evaluate and improve contract lifecycle processes to reduce friction and cycle time.  Help define best practices for contract amendments, churn handling, and renewals.  Contribute to documentation, playbooks, and operational standards.    Requirements and qualifications   Strong knowledge of Salesforce, including data management, reporting, and contract-related objects.  Experience in contract operations, renewal operations, or commercial operations within a SaaS or subscription-based business.  Solid understanding of:  Subscription contracts  Amendments and renewals  Commercial and revenue implications of contract changes  High attention to detail with a strong commitment to data accuracy and compliance.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  Advanced Enlgish.   Ability to manage multiple contract workflows in a fast-paced environment.  Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel).    Nice to have:   Experience with CLM tools or Salesforce CPQ.  Familiarity with billing and finance system integrations.  Knowledge of SaaS revenue models and churn mechanics.    What we can offer you at Cyncly   National Medical Health Plan (Unimed);  National Dental Assistance (Unimed);  Maternity & Paternity extension leave;  Life Insurance;  Meal/ Restaurant allowance (Alelo Tudo);  Home office allowance (if applicable);  Education Platforms and training funding;  Gympass, Zenklub (Health app) and Guapeco (Pet Plan);  Annual Profit Sharing Program;  DayOff as a birthday gift;  Agreement with pharmacies, restaurants and theaters.    Working for us  At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.  Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.  We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.  If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - come join us.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Responsibilities  About the Role  The Societal Safety unit ensures our monetization practices do not contribute to societal harm. We identify emerging risks, from election integrity and misinformation to AI-generated content and minor safety, to ensure ads do not undermine societal stability or individual safety.  As a Policy Manager, you will assess risk and develop clear, "MECE" (Mutually Exclusive, Collectively Exhaustive) policies in TikTok’s most complex regulatory environments. You will balance revenue opportunities with platform integrity, ensuring our rules are enforceable by both human moderators and LLMs.  Responsibilities:   Policy Design: Develop and iterate on global ad policies covering sensitive areas like political advertising, war-related content, and youth safety.  Strategic Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to support aligned, well-informed policy decisions and enforcement approaches that balance revenue with societal safety.  Escalation Support: Contribute to timely, coordinated responses to regional policy questions and high-profile escalations in partnership with GR and PR, AdEx etc.  Trend Monitoring: Monitor regulatory developments, industry trends, and enforcement signals to ensure consistent and responsible policy application across the region.  Continuous Iteration: Support policy development by identifying gaps or emerging risks in the monetization ecosystem and proposing clarifications or improvements.  Operationalization: Monitor enforcement signals to improve policy effectiveness and ensure compliance with global regulatory standards.  Compliance and Transparency: Regularly lead or contribute to FRIs, transparency reports, audits preparation    Qualifications  Minimum Qualifications:   Education: Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, Law, Political Science, or a related field.  Experience: 5+ years in advertising policy, compliance, regulatory affairs, or digital platform safety.  Judgment: Proven ability to navigate "gray areas" and exercise sound judgment on sensitive societal issues.  Communication: Strong English written skills, with an ability to explain complex policy logic clearly to communicate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.  Global Mindset: Experience working across diverse time zones and cultural contexts.    Preferred Qualifications:   Master’s degree in a related field.  Experience using data-driven insights (e.g., analyzing enforcement trends or risk signals) to inform policy iterations and measure the impact of safety interventions.  Experience translating policy intent into scalable processes for AI or human moderation.  Proven track record of managing high-profile escalations or 'gray area' content decisions where multiple safety and business interests are in tension.  Experience acting as a bridge between technical product teams and non-technical stakeholders to build consensus on sensitive issues and facilitate seamless policy iteration.    About ByteDance Brazil  ByteDance is a global incubator of platforms at the cutting edge of commerce, content, entertainment, and enterprise services - over 2.5 billion people interact with ByteDance products, including TikTok.  Why Join Us  Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.  We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.  Diversity & Inclusion  TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too. Procuramos um(a) Analista de Segurança SOC - Nível 2 (Investigação e Resposta)  para atuar na área de Segurança da Informação, com foco em investigação e resposta a incidentes. O(a) profissional será responsável por conduzir análises avançadas de alertas escalados pelo Nível 1, identificar a extensão de comprometimentos, determinar causas raiz e coordenar ações de contenção e erradicação. Conduzir o ciclo de vida de resposta a incidentes, desde a contenção técnica até a recomendação de medidas de erradicação.  Executar atividades de threat hunting, realizando buscas proativas por ameaças que não geraram alertas automáticos. Conhecimento em infraestrutura de redes, incluindo protocolos de roteamento, VLANs e segmentação de rede voltada à segurança.  Experiência em administração de firewalls (Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point ou similares) e VPNs.  Domínio em plataformas EDR/XDR (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender, Trend Micro, Bitdefender ou similares).  Experiência em análise de logs e uso de SIEM, incluindo criação de queries e dashboards (KQL, SPL ou Lucene).  Capacidade de análise de tráfego e reconstrução de ataques por meio de PCAPs e logs de Proxy/WAF.  Conhecimento do framework MITRE ATT&CK para identificação de táticas e técnicas utilizadas por adversários.    Formação e certificações   Graduação em Segurança da Informação, Redes de Computadores, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.    Diferenciais   Certificações como Desec DCPT, CompTIA CySA+, GCIH (GIAC Certified Incident Handler), EC-Council CEH ou similares.  Conhecimento em automação de segurança (SOAR) e linguagens de programação, como Python.  Experiência avançada com ferramentas EDR como CrowdStrike, SentinelOne ou Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  Conhecimento em forense digital, incluindo análise de memória, disco e artefatos de persistência em Windows e Linux.  Experiência em segurança e investigação de incidentes em ambientes de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP).     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Banco de Talentos - Carreira Comercial
description:
Nova oportunidade para Banco de Talentos - Carreira Comercial em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Na Mindsight, desenvolvemos softwares inteligentes para a gestão de pessoas. Nossa missão é levar escalabilidade e embasamento às decisões sobre candidatos e colaboradores, unindo tecnologia e metodologia. Buscamos pessoas que queiram impactar e evoluir o mercado, encarando com energia os desafios do nosso ambiente. Nosso propósito é tornar as decisões sobre gente mais justas, impulsionando resultados reais para o RH.  O QUE VALORIZAMOS NO NOSSO TIME    Profundidade     Resolvemos problemas da melhor maneira possível, aplicando conhecimento na prática e transformando teoria em valor.   Generalismo     Valorizamos pessoas que conhecem um pouco de tudo e não têm medo de contribuir com opiniões para resolver desafios.   Franqueza     Somos diretos. Não incentivamos politicagem nem esforços para “aparecer”. Nosso foco é evoluir o produto e inovar.   Talentos são o nosso core     Somos uma empresa orientada a pessoas, não à burocracia. A autonomia vem com responsabilidade, confiança e qualidade nas entregas — microgestão não faz parte do nosso dia a dia.   Evolução constante     Estamos sempre avaliando, ajustando e buscando melhorar. Quando necessário, mudamos rápido para chegar ao melhor resultado possível.  O QUE ESPERAR DA MINDSIGHT    Impulsionamos seu desenvolvimento     Somos um ambiente de desafios, onde aprendizado vira prática. Oferecemos auxílio educação para apoiar seu crescimento com livros, cursos e eventos.   Autonomia real     Nossa estrutura é horizontal. Você é dono das suas entregas — com independência, iniciativa e responsabilidade.   Flexibilidade de verdade     Pouca burocracia e muita flexibilidade. Você organiza seus próprios horários, seja no modelo remoto ou híbrido. Temos escritório de apoio em São Paulo.   Seja você mesmo     Não julgamos aparência, roupas, cargos ou status. Valorizamos autenticidade e impacto.   Transparência sempre     Feedback é parte da nossa cultura. E quando o assunto é sensível, você conta com o apoio da nossa Ouvidoria.  COMO É FAZER PARTE DO NOSSO TIME COMERCIAL?   Fazer parte do time comercial da Mindsight é ser responsável por mover o crescimento da empresa. Nossa missão é clara: garantir um crescimento sustentável e previsível , trazendo novos clientes, expandindo nossa base ativa e fortalecendo a Mindsight como referência no mercado de RH. Cada pessoa da área comercial contribui diretamente para esse propósito.  Aqui, o trabalho não é apenas vender — é entender profundamente o cliente, diagnosticar suas dores e conectar nossa solução ao impacto real que ela gera na operação dele . É aprendizado constante, evolução rápida e responsabilidade desde o primeiro dia.  É uma trilha para quem gosta de desafios, de pensar com visão de dono e de fazer parte de um time que trabalha com propósito: entregar impacto real para nossos clientes e para o mercado de RH.     POSSIBILIDADES DE ATUAÇÃO   Dentro da Trilha Comercial, você pode se desenvolver em diferentes frentes, cada uma contribuindo para o mesmo objetivo: crescimento sustentável, geração de valor e impacto no cliente .  ➡️ Pré-Vendas   O início da jornada para quem quer aprender a analisar contextos, qualificar leads e gerar oportunidades reais. Excelente porta de entrada para desenvolvimento comercial.  ➡️ Vendas   Atuação direta com diagnóstico, demonstração e fechamento. Aqui você se aprofunda na nossa tese de valor e na capacidade de transformar o negócio dos clientes.  ➡️ Parcerias (Sales Partnerships)   Atuação com parceiros estratégicos, construindo iniciativas que expandem nossa presença e fortalecem nossa base de clientes.  IMPACTO ESPERADO:     1. Aprender a gerar valor antes de gerar venda   A trilha começa desenvolvendo uma visão consultiva: analisar o cliente, entender o contexto, identificar oportunidades e conectar necessidades ao potencial dos nossos produtos.  O foco é sempre impacto, nunca transação.    2. Construir oportunidades — não esperar por elas   A área comercial funciona como um motor estratégico da empresa.  Na trilha, você aprende a:   criar demanda,  qualificar conversas,  transformar dores em propostas de valor,  e acompanhar oportunidades do início ao fim.    Independente da frente de atuação você participa da construção ativa do crescimento da Mindsight.    3. Desenvolver visão de negócio e escuta estratégica   Aqui você aprende a conversar com empresas de diferentes portes e maturidades, traduzir desafios em soluções e apresentar valor de forma clara.  É uma trilha para quem gosta de compreender dores e conectá-las com o valor real que as nossas soluções entregam.    4. Crescer com base em impacto e entrega real   A trilha comercial tem espaço para quem aprende rápido, gosta de desafios e quer crescer. Aqui, desenvolvimento não é promessa: é rotina.  Com feedbacks, rituais, acompanhamento e projetos reais, você evolui enquanto ajuda a escalar a empresa.  SKILLS RELEVANTES    Comunicação consultiva  Análise de contexto e diagnóstico  Visão estratégica de funil e jornada  Entendimento profundo do produto e do impacto gerado  Negociação e storytelling de valor  Trabalho em equipe e colaboração entre áreas  Capacidade de gerar crescimento real e mensurável      Curtiu até aqui?   Se você se enxergou nessas possibilidades e quer crescer em um time guiado por impacto, desempenho e aprendizado contínuo  ➡️ Se inscreva no nosso Banco de Talentos   Quem sabe seu próximo passo não é aqui com a gente? 🚀    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Experiência com atendimento para atletas.  Experiência de mais de 5 anos na área. Acompanhamento e Reavaliação: Acompanhar o progresso dos alunos, realizando reavaliações periódicas e ajustando os treinos conforme a evolução e os novos objetivos.  Manutenção e Organização da Área de Musculação: Zelar pela organização e limpeza dos equipamentos e da área de treinamento, reportando quaisquer problemas ou necessidades de manutenção.  Participação em Treinamentos e Reuniões: Participar de treinamentos internos, workshops e reuniões da equipe para atualização de conhecimentos e alinhamento de procedimentos.  Atendimento ao Cliente: Prestar um atendimento cordial e eficiente aos alunos, sanando dúvidas e oferecendo suporte sempre que necessário. description:

Overview SumUp enables businesses to get paid easily, process orders quickly, sell online instantly and manage their money more efficiently. We create the tools businesses need to make their business and their customer experience thrive! You will be part of SumUp's Brazil Controlling team, sitting at the intersection of regulatory compliance, financial reporting, and strategic operations in one of the most complex and exciting fintech environments in Latin America. Operating within a regulated multi-entity structure, including SumUp IP and SumUp SCD, both supervised by the Brazilian Central Bank, our Controlling team ensures the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial information across all Brazilian legal entities. This is a unique opportunity to join a lean, high-impact team at a critical inflection point. SumUp Brazil is actively pursuing a new financial license (SCFI — Sociedade de Crédito, Financiamento e Investimento), which will significantly expand the complexity and strategic importance of our local financial operations. You will contribute directly to the team's mission of building a more robust, scalable, and process-driven Controlling function, and your work will be visible at the highest levels of our global Finance organisation. Reporting to the Entity Controller for Brazil, you will work closely with our Controlling Specialist, and engage regularly with our Global Accounting Operations, Tax, FP&A, Treasury and other teams across Brazil and Europe.  Responsibilities Own and execute monthly Balance Sheet reconciliations and account substantiation packages for assigned Brazilian entities, ensuring accuracy and audit readiness at every close cycle Execute Month-End Close (MEC) reviews across key areas including Fixed Assets, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Deferred Expenses, Deposits, LTN/LFT, Payments Transactions (TPV), Revenue Recognition, Prepayments, among others Support the preparation and data gathering for Brazilian regulatory filings (ECD) in coordination with the Tax team Reconcile intercompany balances with the Global Accounting Operations team and support CADOC regulatory reporting Attend external auditors and contribute to the preparation of the Financial Statements and Automations project, helping build a more efficient and scalable preparation process for the financial statements of all Brazilian entities Engage with multiple international stakeholders in English, supporting cross-functional requests from FP&A, Treasury, Global Process Owners, and external auditors   Qualifications You have 4 to 6 years of experience in Controlling, Accounting, and/or Audit (Big4) in a structured finance environment, ideally within a regulated institution (bank, payment institution, or fintech) You have solid, hands-on knowledge of Brazilian GAAP (BR GAAP) and IFRS fundamentals, with direct experience in month-end close and Balance Sheet reconciliations You are familiar with Brazilian regulatory reporting requirements, and ideally have exposure to BCB/COSIF environments and CADOC reporting You are proficient in SAP or an equivalent ERP, and have advanced GSheets/Excel skills You are a proactive and reliable communicator, comfortable working with cross-functional and international teams in both Portuguese and English You have a strong ownership mindset, you take your deliverables end-to-end, identify root causes, and propose solutions rather than just escalating problems Experience with automation tools like Python, Zapier, Make.com and Langdock is a plus Curiosity about AI tools to accelerate work and process improvements is highly valued Experience with Financial Products like CDB, Derivatives, and Credit Card from an SCFI Company is a plus   Why you should join SumUp   Global Experience : Collaborate with a diverse team of 3,000+ people from over 90 countries, and join our global off-sites and hackathons. 🤝 Collaborative Culture : Join a team that values diversity, innovation, and teamwork, where your ideas and contributions truly matter.   Career Growth : Be part of a global team working on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses.   Great Benefits : Health plans, meal vouchers (VR), Zenklub, Wellhub, life insurance, childcare allowance, and more.   Learning & Development : Access an annual budget of R$ 10,000  for education, certifications, and conferences.   Time Off : Enjoy 30 additional days off  through our Break4Me  program after 3 years at SumUp.   Grow with Us : Participate in our virtual stock program and benefit from SumUp’s success with company shares.   Learn More About SumUp 🇧🇷 Office tour at São Paulo   Ask me anything: Engineering at SumUp 🚀 SumUp’s Innovation Hackathon 🤝 Get to know our hiring process   Ready to Join us? Apply now and help us shape the future of financial solutions for small businesses  Job Application Tip We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: GTM Lead
description:
Empresa está contratando GTM Lead em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

You will build Bleu's revenue machine from zero. This is not a role where you inherit a pipeline and optimize it. There is no pipeline. There is: real proof (strong case studies + references) a clear quality bar and delivery track record validated service patterns (we know what works) founders who will work closely with you  Your job is to turn that into a repeatable GTM system. What you'll own Turn what we already do well into 2–3 clear, repeatable offers (less bespoke proposals every time) Define who we're for — and who we're not for Protect margin and apply guardrails (no vague scope, no "staff aug", no deals that create scope creep) Build the basics in a CRM of your choice (stages, qualification criteria, templates, weekly cadence) Create a proposal/contract process that fits consultative, high-trust sales Close the loop with delivery so we keep selling what we're genuinely best at  Demand generation (hands-on) Outbound + ecosystem work: LinkedIn, warm intros, partner conversations—in Bleu's voice (direct, consultative, substance > hype) — you prospect, qualify, and close while building the sales playbook Turn proof into assets (references, case studies, short narratives) instead of "nice quotes" Work with founders on a consistent content cadence (e.g., ~2 posts/week)  Team (once the system works) Hire and manage a BDR to run the playbook you build, and/or build an AI agent for that. Define what a "qualified meeting" is so the BDR generates real opportunities  What you won't own Product decisions or roadmap Delivery management or post-sale customer success Engineering priorities or team management Brand marketing / creative direction (you'll collaborate with cases and content creation, but you won't be "the brand team")  You'll do well here if you… Have sold or built GTM for technical services / engineering partnerships / productized dev work (not enterprise SaaS-only) Can hold a real conversation with technical buyers (founders, CTOs, eng leads) without fluff Don't think that doing the prospecting yourself is unacceptable — you know that's the job Write clearly and directly (if your default is buzzwords/corporate-speak, this won't fit) Have high autonomy and like building systems (you don't need daily orchestration) Know when to say no to deals that look good on paper but damage margin, scope, or team focus  Nice to have Experience selling to technical buyers in both Web2 and Web3 Prior experience hiring/training a BDR Familiarity with the Brazilian market (we're expanding Brazil as a channel too, without losing global focus)  Logistics Remote (timezone range: UTC-8 to UTC+1) Work closely with the founders (José + Fábio) and delivery leads  Hiring process (3–4 weeks) 2. Paid async work sample (~3–4h) — ICP definition, offer framing, 30-day outbound plan, LinkedIn message, pipeline criteria 3. Deep dive (90 min) — work sample presentation + discovery call roleplay + pressure scenarios 4. Final conversation (45 min, both founders) — long-term alignment  Compensation - Base + variable (OTE~ USD 100k/year) - We use a fair ramp: early months focus on building the system and creating qualified pipeline before fully shifting incentives toward closed revenue - Details shared in the interview process    #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Uma empresa GPTW que se orgulha das suas pessoas e que busca oferecer jornadas de crescimento, aprendizado e valorizando a diversidade de pessoas e de pensamentos.  Porque é mais que uma vaga. É uma vaga na Senior.  Sobre o Desafio  Como Coordenador(a) de Geração de Demanda, você será responsável por liderar uma de nossas equipes de Desenvolvimento de Receita, focada em gerar leads qualificados para o time de vendas.  Suas responsabilidades incluem orientar e treinar a equipe BDR, colaborar estreitamente com vendas e produtos para alinhar estratégias, implementar processos eficientes de qualificação de leads e acompanhar métricas de desempenho.  Principais Responsabilidades   Desenvolver e implementar estratégias eficazes de prospecção para atingir as metas de crescimento da empresa;  Colaborar com as equipes de marketing, vendas e produto para alinhar esforços e otimizar a jornada do cliente;  Identificar oportunidades de mercado e áreas para expansão;  Gerenciar e liderar uma equipe de profissionais de prospecção, proporcionando orientação e suporte para garantir o desempenho máximo;  Garantir a formação continuada e desenvolvimento do time;  Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e motivador;  Estabelecer e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes potenciais, compreendendo suas necessidades e apresentando soluções personalizadas;  Realizar análises de mercado para entender as tendências, demandas e comportamentos dos clientes;  Utilizar dados e métricas para orientar decisões estratégicas;  Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de marketing, vendas e desenvolvimento de produtos para garantir uma abordagem integrada e eficaz;  Ser responsável e protagonista na missão de alavancar o resultado final de vendas por meio do time de BDR.    Que Esperamos De Você   Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Comunicação, Administração ou área relacionada.  Domínio em liderança de pessoas e talentos;  Conhecimento profundo de estratégias de outbound marketing;  Experiência em prospecção, geração de demanda, growth, preferencialmente em empresas de tecnologia;  Familiaridade com os segmentos de RH, ERP e demais sistemas de gestão;  Conhecimento de métricas e indicadores de marketing/vendas e geração de demanda;  Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;  Disponibilidade para viagens.  Que Pode Potencializar Sua Candidatura  Pós-graduação ou MBA;  Conhecimento de máquina de vendas;  Experiência em liderança de times de geração de demandas e vendas para B2B;  Conhecimento em inbound marketing/sales;  Conhecimento de Exact Sales / Hubspot / Linkedin Sales Navigator / Ramper / Neoway;  Conhecimento de Spin selling, Bant e outras metodologias de venda consultiva;  Inglês e/ou Espanhol Fluente.    Nossos Benefícios   Convênio Médico e Odontológico;  Seguro de Vida;  PPLR - Participação nos lucros e resultados;  Cartão Wiipo com benefícios flexíveis;  Clube Wiipo com descontos e vantagens exclusivas;  TotalPass - Benefício de academias e bem-estar;  OnHappy - Benefício de vantagens para viagens;  Banco de horas;  Empresa cidadã: Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;  Assistência natalidade;  Assistência PET;  Universidade Corporativa Senior;  Plano de desenvolvimento de carreira.    O Nosso Jeito Senior De Ser  Nossa cultura respeita as individualidades e potencializa as pessoas com inovação, colaboração e autonomia. Acreditamos na pluralidade, pois as experiências e perspectivas são únicas, com oportunidades que incluem diversidade de pessoas e de pensamentos. Porque é dessa forma que alcançamos grandes resultados, que geram o sucesso dos clientes, movidos pela dedicação de pessoas incríveis. Estas informações são específicas para esta oportunidade, mas você pode conferir todas as nossas vagas e ainda mais sobre como é ser Senior na nossa página de carreiras: senior.com.br/carreiras  Somos mais Senior!   Somos uma empresa brasileira reconhecida como uma das maiores desenvolvedoras de software para gestão do país. Com mais de 35 anos de história e atuação em todo o Brasil, impulsionamos a transformação digital de milhares de empresas por meio da tecnologia. Expandimos nossa presença para o mercado internacional com a aquisição de uma empresa na Colômbia, fortalecendo nossa atuação na América Latina. A qualidade das nossas soluções é resultado do trabalho de mais de 3.600 pessoas e de um portfólio completo voltado à alta performance. description:

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW)  in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.  Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils  in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast.  Our company culture blends people-first care  and performance excellence.  The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symoolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.  We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens.  You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us.  Check out our Culture page here  About The Role  We’re looking for an Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to our CEO, Felix, and key stakeholders. You will be the backbone of our executive operations, ensuring that leadership can focus on scaling InPlanet while you manage the complexity of their daily lives with agility, trust, and extreme discretion.  You’ll be the kind of person who is a natural problem-solver, highly organized, and comfortable connecting the dots in a fast-paced environment—always maintaining the highest standards of discretion while handling sensitive information and founder-level matters with absolute trust. You’ll act as a true partner, managing priorities and communication to ensure our founders stay effective and focused on our mission.  The Impact you can make  Your work will directly increase the effectiveness of our CEO and leadership team. By bringing clarity to communication, structure to priorities, and ownership to execution, you enable faster and better decision-making across the company.  You won’t just manage tasks: you will own outcomes , ensuring that priorities move forward and nothing falls through the cracks.  Core working relationships   Felix (CEO) – direct report and primary priority for support  Key stakeholders (CFO, COO, co-founder) – occasional support for meetings, travel, and specific demands  External Partners – coordinating with notaries, providers, and global contacts    Key Responsibilities   Structure and manage complex calendars and meetings, prioritizing urgencies and ensuring a smooth schedule  Manage executive inboxes, including reading, drafting answers, and prioritizing threads and forwards  Provide support for personal agenda and private administrative tasks as needed to optimize the CEO's time  Join meetings to collect insights, document action items, and provide clear summaries  Lead certain initiatives from start to finish, such as scheduling notary dates and With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.  About AB InBev Growth Group  Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world. What you'll do:   Support the intake process for ABI mature markets, ensuring business cases are properly documented, structured, and tracked.  Ensure strong process documentation and knowledge management, centralizing information in shared tools.  Consolidate and analyze data related to business cases, product initiatives, and market requests.  Evaluate and model the expected OKR impact of proposed business cases to support quantitative prioritization decisions.  Structure, collect, and consolidate market satisfaction survey results regarding the intake process, ensuring visibility of opportunities and generating persona-based findings.  Prepare reports, dashboards, and executive-ready materials that clearly communicate insights and performance.    What you'll need:   University degree in a field related to the role;  Strong analytical skills, with the ability to organize complex information into structured insights;  Experience working with SQL/Python (recommended), Excel and Power Point;  Understanding process tracking, data analysis, or program support;  Solid documentation and process organization skills;  Familiarity with product or digital environments;  Highly Organized: Strong attention to detail, documentation, and follow-through;  Analytical & Structured Thinking: Ability to connect data points, identify patterns, and support decision-making;  Adaptable: Thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments with changing priorities;     #J-18808-Ljbffr

Conhecimento em UX Research, testes de usabilidade e validação de hipóteses.  Experiência ou interesse em produtos SaaS, plataformas B2B ou sistemas complexos. Respond to client inquiries promptly and professionally, ensuring a positive customer experience.  Utilize Eurasia Group’s cloud‑based business intelligence platform to produce regular reports and ad‑hoc analysis of research production and consumption, and analyze readership trends in various segments of the client base.  Report regularly on interactions with specific clients to ensure compliance with research‑related regulations.  Direct website inquiries to the appropriate client services teams.  Approve requests for access to Eurasia Group content on various research aggregation platforms.  Ad hoc projects as required.    Required Skills   Strong English oral and written communication skills.  Demonstrated professionalism, problem solving, teamwork skills, confidentiality, discretion, reliability, and judgment; positive can‑do attitude; someone who will “own” the role.  Agility and flexibility in response to changing priorities and needs.  Fluency with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Zoom, and Salesforce.com CRM system and ability to pick up and learn new technologies as needed.  Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.  Ability to meet deadlines.    Additional Requirements   Undergraduate/first‑level degree (e.g., bachelor’s degree) desired with coursework in business administration or related field.  1‑2+ years’ experience in a professional services environment, especially a corporate sales, operations, or events function.  Experience interfacing with multinational corporations.  A strong interest in international affairs and politics, including an understanding of Eurasia Group’s core services.    At Eurasia Group, our mission is to provide the tools and understanding needed in a world where politics drives disruption. We put politics first  for our clients, and we aspire to be the leading place people come to find out about the world. This requires us to maintain a company culture that puts people first. We are committed to fostering an environment that is empowering and globally minded. We firmly believe that bringing people with a variety of ideas and perspectives to the table makes our analysis stronger for our clients and creates a better workplace. Overview The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 220 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 145k+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Been ranked as one of Europe’s most promising privately held SaaS startups (4th in Sifted’s 2025 B2B SaaS Rising 100) Raised $240m to date, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our recent $180m Series C - bringing us to a $2.5bn valuation  That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register. We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. Role We’re looking for a seasoned Product Designer  who thrives in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces. n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope. We’re currently hiring for different teams with specific focus on: Enterprise: You’ve worked on technical B2B platforms where workflows are the product. You’ve designed for scale, governance and collaboration across teams including permissions, environments, observability and failure modes included and you’re comfortable making deeply complex systems feel coherent and simple. AI: This team is perfect for designers who’ve worked on AI tools, agents, or builders and want to push the boundaries of AI-powered automation. You'll define the future of AI-powered workflows. Growth: We're seeking a designer who thrives on rapid iteration and experimentation. You have experience optimizing onboarding and activation flows, you're motivated by moving metrics, and you excel at testing, learning, and iterating quickly. Marketplace: This role is ideal for designers experienced with multi-sided platforms where you balance distinct needs of the supply and demand sides. The Senior Aerospace Systems Safety Engineer will be responsible for working cross functionally to ensure airplane level safety analyses are appropriately conducted. Understanding the complex integration of airplane systems, human factors, and airplane integration into the operational environment are required in this role. If you’re ready for a challenging new role that is critical to the success of our programs then this might be the job for you. Successful candidates will be reliable, trustworthy, and accountable for delivering results. Familiarity with ARP-4754, ARP-4761, safety analysis, and hazard assessments will greatly benefit you in this role.  Primary Responsibilities   Provide safety design and analysis expertise to program stakeholders and leadership  Validate and verify airplane level safety requirements  Develop certification strategies for systems and airplane level safety issues  Execute airplane level threat analyses (bird strike, rotorburst, cargo fire, tire and wheel failures, etc.)  Ensure adequate redundancy and physical separation of critical systems  Lead airplane level safety analyses like Runway Excursion or Airplane Common Mode to ensure integration across multiple functional systems  Design and update safety processes according to the last industry standards, regulations, best practices, and lessons    Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience)   Must have existing rights to work in Brazil.  Must have a bachelor’s degree in engineering.  Must be registered or eligible to register with the Engineering and Agronomy Regional Council (Conselho Regional de Engenharia e Agronomia - CREA).  Proficient in both verbal and written communications skills in the English Language  In depth experience with safety requirements, system safety analysis such as Risk Assessments, Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Fault-tree Analysis (FTA), Systems Safety Assessment, and system design or integration.    Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience)   Familiarity with FAR Part  , and industry practices like ARP 4761 & 4754  Familiarity working with FAA  Experience with certification plan  Experience with airplane level threat analyses (bird strike, rotor burst, cargo fire, tire and wheel failures, etc.)    Relocation  This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.  Additional Information  This requisition is for a locally hired position in Brazil. Candidates must have current legal authorization to live and work in Brazil. O que não se aprende rápido é saber ler um funil, identificar onde o consultor está perdendo o cliente, dar um feedback que muda comportamento e construir uma máquina que gera tanto novas vendas quanto recorrência na nossa base atual, não só quando o time está inspirado. O que você precisa trazer   Já liderou time comercial com meta individual e coletiva — mesmo que pequeno  Domina gestão de funil: sabe onde o lead para, por quê e como mover  Tem experiência com gestão de carteira (Farming): sabe trabalhar o ciclo de vida do cliente (LTV) e não olha apenas para a primeira venda.  Trabalha com indicadores no dia a dia — não só no fechamento do mês  Faz escuta de atendimento e dá feedback que muda comportamento  Tem vivência com ticket médio relevante — produto ou serviço acima de R$ 5k  É operacional: acompanha de perto, não só pelo dashboard  Já montou ou reestruturou processo comercial do zero  Tem experiência com CRM e cultura de registro no time  Vem de comercial B2B com perfil de cliente exigente — e quer aplicar essa visão num B2C em crescimento acelerado  Tem curiosidade natural por produto de design, lifestyle ou alto padrão.    Remuneração    Variável atrelado ao resultado do time — conversão, ticket médio e atingimento de meta coletiva    Presencial em São Paulo | Seg–Sex  Acreditamos que o líder precisa ganhar quando o time ganha. Vamos alinhar os números na conversa, com transparência.  Como trabalhamos  Somos uma empresa jovem, em crescimento acelerado, com tudo ainda sendo construído. Isso significa autonomia real, impacto direto e muito espaço para quem quer deixar marca — mas também significa que você vai precisar montar estrutura onde ainda não existe.  Se você precisa de tudo pronto para trabalhar, esse não é o lugar certo. Se você gosta de construir, vai se sentir em casa.  Se faz sentido pra você, faz sentido pra gente conversar.  Candidate-se aqui pelo LinkedIn ou envie mensagem direta. Na primeira conversa, vamos entender seu momento e apresentar a oportunidade com transparência — incluindo a remuneração.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

We are looking for a long-term partner (5+ years) to join our team, own the marketing function entirely, and drive our next phase of growth.  The Role  RevBlack is seeking a Marketing Lead (HubSpot- RevOps)  to drive our revenue-generation ecosystem. You will take charge of a specialized three-person squad (Content, Design, and Ops) that possesses high potential and is ready to reach elite performance levels under a culture of radical ownership.  This is not a position for an "overseer" who stays in the shadows of delegation. You must be eager to own our technological stack, master our data architecture, and execute the growth roadmap. Your primary objective is to accelerate our pipeline through surgical engagement with Private Equity partners and the delivery of premium-tier content.  Your Core Responsibilities  1. Leadership & Accountability (The "Coach")   Team Orchestration:  Supervise the daily production of our creative and administrative talent. Your mission is to professionalize their output and elevate their standards through active development and clear performance benchmarks.  Commitment to Craftsmanship:  We have zero tolerance for "average." You will audit every campaign and piece of copy to ensure it aligns with our high-end standards of excellence. AI should be leveraged for scale, but it must never replace human market intelligence or creative depth.  Full Functional Accountability:  You are the ultimate authority on marketing outcomes. If a project stalls or a workflow breaks, you don’t shift blame. You lead the correction, the post-mortem analysis, and the strategy to ensure it doesn't happen again.    2. Marketing Operations & Strategy (The "Player")   Systems & CRM Architecture:  Deep, hands-on mastery of HubSpot  is mandatory. You will be responsible for auditing automations, architecting transparent reporting, and ensuring our CRM data is clean, actionable, and scalable.  Precision Pipeline Growth:  We avoid mass-blast noise. You will design and execute sophisticated, high-touch campaigns aimed specifically at Private Equity operating partners and B2B leadership.  High-End Referral Ecosystems:  Develop and manage a structured referral engine that maintains a personal, premium feel while being engineered for high-volume scale.  Analytics-Based Strategy:  You will rely on historical data to identify winning strategies rather than guesswork. You will establish clear KPIs and take 100% responsibility for hitting them.    3. Operational Discipline (EOS)  RevBlack is powered by the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) . In this role, you will be the driving force behind our marketing rhythm. This includes architecting quarterly "Rocks," facilitating high-impact L10 meetings, and maintaining the integrity of the marketing scorecard. While prior EOS exposure is a major asset, a relentless commitment to mastering this framework is mandatory for success.  The Ideal Candidate   Veteran B2B Leader:  You possess a proven track record of managing talent and scaling revenue within a consultancy or professional services environment.  MarTech Specialist:  Deep, hands‑on expertise in HubSpot (Marketing Ops) is non‑negotiable. We also value familiarity with Webflow and a strategic approach to SEO.  Pipeline Architect:  You are obsessed with results, not just "vanity metrics." You know how to build a sales pipeline that is both measurable and predictable.  Radical Candor:  You thrive in an environment of high standards. You provide feedback that is direct, productive, and aligned with The RevBlack Diamond Rule .  Strategic Owner:  You don’t wait for a roadmap; you build it. You bring the CEO solutions and fresh perspectives, viewing every obstacle as a catalyst for growth.    Our Core Values  We hire, fire, review, and reward based on these values.   100% Responsibility:  We own our choices and outcomes. We don’t make excuses, blame others, or hide mistakes.  The Obstacle is the Way:  We don't just endure challenges; we get curious about them. We turn negatives into positives and use obstacles to improve our condition.  Set and Meet Expectations:  We build trust by being clear about what we will do and when. If we say it will be done, it gets done.  Craftsmanship:  We take pride in doing great work. We are meticulous, patient, and detail-oriented—like a watchmaker ensuring every piece is perfect.  The RevBlack Diamond Rule:  We cultivate high emotional intelligence. We ensure that every client and team member feels better, more secure, and more understood after interacting with us    Why Join RevBlack?   Impact:  You will work directly with the CEO and shape the future of the company.  Growth:  We are growing year-over-year with big goals for 2026 and beyond.  Culture:  A high-performance team that solves hard problems together, supports one another, and dislikes office politics.     #J-18808-Ljbffr
